Color Palettes

Source: R/palettes.R
palettes.Rd

Built-in color palettes for network visualization.

Examples

palette_blues(5)
#> [1] "#F7FBFF" "#CCDEF1" "#84BBDB" "#3989C1" "#084594"
palette_reds(5)
#> [1] "#FFF5F0" "#FCC4AD" "#FB7D5D" "#E53228" "#99000D"
